units.source_text: 惟光的哥哥阿阇梨[\[7\]](#part1333.html#m7)、妹夫三河守和妹妹都在这里。

en.t: Koremitsu's elder brother, the Ajari, his brother-in-law, the Governor of Mikawa, and his younger sister were all here.

units.source_text: 他们看见源氏公子光临，认为莫大荣幸，大家惶恐致谢。

en.t: When they saw Prince Genji arrive, they took it as a very great honor, and all humbly offered their thanks.

units.source_text: 做了尼姑的乳母也起身对公子说：“我这身体已死不足惜。

en.t: The nurse, who had become a nun, also raised herself and said to the prince, "This body of mine is not worth regretting even if it dies.

units.source_text: 所恋恋不舍者，只是削发之后无缘会见公子，实为遗憾，因此踌躇不决。

en.t: The only thing I could not let go of was the regret that, after shaving my head, I would have no chance to see you again; that is why I hesitated.

units.source_text: 今幸蒙佛力加被，去病延年，仍得拜见公子光临，心愿已足。

en.t: Now, happily blessed by the Buddha's power, my illness has left me and my life has been prolonged, and I have been able once more to see you come here; my wish is fulfilled.

units.source_text: 今后便可放怀一切，静候阿弥陀佛召唤了。”

en.t: From now on I can release all attachments and quietly wait for Amida Buddha to call me."
When she had finished speaking, she could not help weeping in sorrow.

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“前日听说妈妈身上不好，我心中一直挂念。

en.t: Prince Genji said, "The other day I heard that you were unwell, and I have been worried about you ever since.

units.source_text: 如今又闻削发为尼，遁入空门，更是不胜悲叹。

en.t: Now that I have also heard you have shaved your head, become a nun, and entered the Buddhist path, my grief is even harder to bear.

units.source_text: 今后但愿妈妈长生不老，看我升官晋爵，然后无障无碍地往生九品净土。

en.t: From now on I only hope that you will live long, see me rise in rank and office, and then pass without hindrance into the nine grades of the Pure Land.

units.source_text: 倘对世间稍有执著，便成恶业，不利于修行，如是我闻。”

en.t: If you hold even the slightest attachment to this world, it becomes bad karma and does not aid your practice, thus have I heard."
As he spoke, he too shed tears.
